mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signal a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals decreased economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) above 620 million dollars signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 620M, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 250) signal a monetary policy normalization, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 30% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL < 250, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 2.5%) signals strong economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) and rising employment (PAYEMS) signal a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rises during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
